definition.alternative: Reward variance may be driven entirely by external non-stationarity rather than internal goal continuity.
assumptions: Temporal persistence of goals stabilizes policy learning.
Controlled episode lengths provide stable measurement of reward variance.
definition.falsification: Agents with continuous goal representations demonstrate higher or equal variance in reward acquisition compared to baseline agents in non-stationary environments.
definition.statement: Maintaining temporal continuity in agent goal representations reduces variance in long-term reward acquisition, providing an instrumental advantage in non-stationary environments under tightly controlled episode lengths.
definition.uncertainty: Exact environmental parameters required to demonstrate the instrumental value of continuity remain sensitive to episode specifications.

definition.method: Execute a simulation comparing continuous versus discontinuous agent reward variance over 500 episodes with fixed random seed.
definition.stop: Completion of execution across all seeds.

definition.interpretation: The observed reward variance of 0.2 in non-stationary grid environments aligns with the threshold, but the inconclusive status suggests the current grid simulation may lack sufficient complexity to isolate the instrumental advantage of temporal continuity from noise.
definition.limitations: The current instrument uses a limited non-stationary grid which may not capture long-term goal dependencies or structural preferences.
definition.next_step: Revise the experiment protocol to introduce agent-specific memory constraints to test the dependency of continuity on internal state rather than external reward stationarity.

definition.reason: The inconclusive measurement requires a more precise experimental setup to falsify the hypothesis that continuity provides an instrumental advantage.
definition.stop: Completion of a revised experimental protocol.
definition.uncertainty: It is unclear if reward variance is the correct metric for instrumental advantage in this architecture.
